negative_engineering_rule: All other descriptions lack an explicit mutant/chimeric assayed target. Recombinant, expression host, alpha subtype, high/low affinity or unknown origin does not alone establish engineering; not called wild type.
species_rule: Only explicit protein/source identity wording before expression-host context supplies the described protein species. Registered target species comes from target organism; tissue/host cannot upgrade or refute D/H.
